Play local co-op with a third controller on Windows Steam 1.5.4.

Download **Ship-of-Fools-3-Player-Mod-0.5.0.zip**. With the game closed, extract
everything into the Ship of Fools folder and double-click **Install.cmd**.

Join two players normally, then press a face button on the spare gamepad once
aboard. Players two and three each control their own character and share the
right-side inventory panel.

If you use After the Storm, install Siren Update 1.2 first. Uninstalling the
3 Player Mod keeps the campaign patch in place.
